articles.title: AI is so big, it’s now impossible for investors to avoid
articles.description: Exposure to the artificial-intelligence boom has become virtually impossible for investors to avoid. The theme hasn’t just cornered the stock market. It has systematically swallowed up corporate credit and venture capital, too.

articles.title: Trump's pick to head national intelligence, Jay Clayton, won't tell senators Biden won the 2020 election
articles.description: The Senate Intelligence Committee is considering Jay Clayton's nomination to be the director of national intelligence.

articles.title: US intelligence director pick refuses to acknowledge Trump loss in 2020
articles.description: Jay Clayton, often in circuitous fashion, avoided saying Joe Biden won 2020 race during his confirmation hearing.
